\section{\texttt{update\_json\_index}}
\label{func:feedback_intelligence_agent.index_updates.update_json_index}\index{Functions!update\_json\_index}

Merge records under a writer lock, then atomically replace the JSON index.
\apifield{Usage}
\begin{lstlisting}[style=usage, language=Python]
